## Context
Cloud summary writes currently cross ACLI subprocess behavior and a shared REST helper that retries three times with 2s/5s waits. The selected route must consume only the shared logical budget without weakening unrelated callers.

## Outcome
Implement one Cloud summary write invocation and primary-store observation under the S1 contract. Each write launches one ACLI process; summary recovery performs one REST request with no inner sleep.

## Plan
1. Add sanitized historical exit/stdout/stderr fixtures, including the real exit-1 unauthorized shape, and fail loud on unknown shapes.
2. Execute one `acli jira workitem edit` process per physical write invocation. Preserve POSIX process-group and non-POSIX child cleanup.
3. Add a per-call retry policy to `_rest_urlopen_with_retry`. `get_issue_by_rest` summary recovery alone selects one attempt/no sleep; every existing caller retains three attempts and 2s/5s waits.
4. Classify auth/TLS/permission/invalid requests as permanent; eligible network, 429, and retryable 5xx outcomes return metadata to the shared budget rather than replaying locally.
5. Observe the primary REST issue resource, never indexed ACLI JQL, before any ambiguous replay.
6. Emit exactly one redacted completion log for every terminal/exhausted outcome or cleanup failure. Include only logical id, disposition, invocation count, request count, cleanup status, `retry_not_before`, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points; cap the whole serialized log at 1,024 Unicode code points.

## Testing
Stateful fakes and real child-process tests assert process/request counts, cleanup, classification, redaction, exact completion-log fields and bounds, one-log emission cardinality, and neighbor retry behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] One Cloud write invocation launches exactly one ACLI process.
- [ ] Summary recovery performs one primary-store REST request with no inner sleep or JQL.
- [ ] All unrelated REST callers retain three attempts with 2s/5s waits.
- [ ] Permanent and transient outcome classes map to the shared contract without adapter replay.
- [ ] Historical triples decode deterministically and unknown triples do not retry.
- [ ] Timeout cleanup passes for POSIX process groups and non-POSIX child processes.
- [ ] Operation diagnostics hold at most eight entries and every message is redacted before its 512-Unicode-code-point cap.
- [ ] Every terminal/exhausted outcome or cleanup failure emits exactly one completion log with only logical id, disposition, invocation/request counts, cleanup status, `retry_not_before`, and one redacted message capped at 512 Unicode code points; the whole log is at most 1,024 Unicode code points.

## Out of scope
Core dispatch cutover and Jira DC execution.
